From v4.0, Remotion has a cache for [`<OffthreadVideo>`](/docs/offthreadvideo) frames. The default is `null`, corresponding to half of the system memory available when the render starts.<br /> This option allows to override the size of the cache. The higher it is, the faster the render will be, but the more memory will be used.<br />The used value will be printed when running in verbose mode.<br />Default: `null`
